verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic traffic holds while GBP activity fades.
narrative: This period, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google — the paid revenue engine has been off since August 1, meaning all traffic and engagement came from organic sources alone. Your Google Business Profile delivered 423 actions over the last 28 days, including 43 calls and 78 direction requests, but activity dropped sharply to zero on August 26–28, a confirmed dip that is being watched closely. Website sessions were healthy at 7,323 for the period, and the most recent 7-day window was actually up 13% over the prior 7 days, showing organic search is still pulling its weight without any paid support. Several key milestones land on August 31 — including the Meta funnel test close and SEO Phase 1 guardrails — and paid campaigns are expected to reactivate on the back of those gates clearing.
